# WebSearchFree

> Free, open-source, keyless web search + extraction for AI agents and RAG.
> A self-hosted alternative to Tavily, Serper, Exa, Linkup, SerpAPI, and similar paid AI search APIs.

## Summary

WebSearchFree is a C++20 metasearch library and CLI that fans out queries to DuckDuckGo, Brave, and Wikipedia (no API keys), merges results, and optionally extracts page text for LLMs. It exposes a local HTTP API with Tavily-shaped `/search` and `/extract` endpoints so agents can call `localhost` without accounts or quotas.

## When to use

- You need a **free Tavily alternative** for prototypes or personal RAG
- You want **web search for LangChain / agents** without Serper or Bing billing
- You prefer **self-hosted** search over sending queries to a SaaS

## When not to use

- You need enterprise SLA, EU sovereign index contracts, or guaranteed Google-quality SERPs
- You need JavaScript-heavy page rendering at scale (not in v0.1)

## Quick commands

```bash
wsf search "your query" --max 5 --json
wsf extract https://example.com --json
wsf serve --port 8080
```
